scenes.title: The 9:09 Panic Attack

data.name: The 9:09 Panic Attack
data.headline: Plank for your price. Or wait for 9:09 and panic with everyone else.
data.benefit: Plank for your price: hold it for 57 seconds and the 9-Class Pack is ₹12,999; hold for 2:57 and it’s ₹11,499. Or wait for 9:09 on 9 April, when everyone gets the floor price for 99 minutes. Panic responsibly.
data.rationale: A price you earn with your body is the most Physique 57 thing there is, and every plank at the desk is a show for whoever is waiting. The floor price (23.7% / 24.0%) sits inside the 25% spot cap, and plan revenue is counted at the floor.
data.audience: Everyone: members, pack buyers and newcomers.
data.conditions: Spot offer, ≤25% effective at the floor price. Two packs per person. April only; no anniversary prices after 30 Apr.
data.kpi: Packs sold in the two 9:09 windows; pack → membership by June.

scenes.title: Plus One, Plus Nine
scenes.narration: Revenue boost: Plus One, Plus Nine. Bring a friend to the party. 1 buyers at 5,891 rupees — 5,891 rupees. 15 per cent off.

data.name: Plus One, Plus Nine
data.headline: Bring a friend, get 9 days. Bring three, get a month.
data.benefit: Bring a friend to the party: if they join, you get 9 extra days. Bring three and the next month is on us. They get 15% off and a Cloud Nine tote.
data.rationale: Referrals convert at 22–76% against 3.8–5.7% for website leads. A tier at three friends gives the super-connectors a reason to keep going.
data.audience: Current members bringing a never-been friend.
data.conditions: Friend must be new to P57. Member reward is acquisition cost, paid only on a purchase.
data.kpi: Referral buyers (target 2× April 2026); members reaching three.

scenes.title: Party Crasher Pass
scenes.narration: New clients: Party Crasher Pass. It’s our 9th birthday and you’re invited. 3 buyers at 4,893 rupees — 14,679 rupees. 15 per cent off.

data.name: Party Crasher Pass
data.headline: It’s our 9th birthday and you’re invited. 3 classes for ₹999.
data.benefit: It’s our 9th birthday and you’re invited: 3 classes for ₹999 (Kenkere ₹699), birthday party class included. Love it? The ₹999 comes off your first month. Decide fast and you get to hit the big red buzzer.
data.rationale: A booked sequence of classes is what converts; the party class gives newcomers the best room of the year, and the buzzer turns a sale into a show for whoever is waiting.
data.conditions: One per phone number. Credit valid 72 hours after class 3. Standard 15% only.
data.kpi: Pass → member (target 35%); buzzer hits (bought within 9 hours).

scenes.title: Faking Your Own Death Didn’t Work
scenes.narration: Win-backs: Faking Your Own Death Didn’t Work. We wrote your obituary. 2 buyers at 7,229 rupees — 14,458 rupees. 20 per cent off.

data.name: Faking Your Own Death Didn’t Work
data.headline: We wrote your obituary. You’re not getting out of it that easily.
data.benefit: We wrote your obituary. It was moving. Unfortunately for you, you’re invited back: 15% off, a bonus for every year you’ve been with us, and a candle-lit Séance Class to rise from the dead.
data.rationale: Lapsed clients already know the product; what they need is a moment and a reason that is not just a discount. A personal postcard with a dated class beats a generic reminder.
data.conditions: Lapsed 61 days–3 years. Standard lapsed 15% + loyalty-year bonus (max 3) = ≤20% effective.
data.kpi: Postcards → Séance Class attendance; reactivations (target +30% vs Apr-26).

data.name: Spin Class (Literally)
data.headline: Renew, then spin. Every spin wins. Feeling brave? Double it.
data.benefit: Renew in April and spin the Wheel of Nine: every spin wins. Then decide: keep your prize, double it, or gift it to a friend. Odds are on the wall, because we’re not that kind of casino.
data.rationale: Clients who use 75%+ of their sessions renew at 80–86%. The doubling option pays the prize only when the member books the classes that make them renew again; the expected value of a spin is ≈₹1,900 Mumbai / ₹1,350 Bengaluru.
data.audience: Members renewing 1 Month or a 12-class pack.
data.conditions: One spin per renewal; published odds; doubled prizes credited only once the 9 classes are attended. ≈19.5% effective on the expected value.
data.kpi: April renewal yield vs April 2026; share of spins doubled (target 35%).

steps.label: W1
steps.text: Set up Spin Class (Literally) in Momence (2027-04-01 to 2027-04-30): Renew 1 Month or a 12-class pack in April at 10% off (₹18,215 / ₹17,719; Kenkere ₹13,136 / ₹11,813; pop-up 10-pack ₹7,655) and spin the Wheel of Nine. Published odds: +1 class 30%, smoothie 20%, guest pass 15%, grip socks 10%, +3 days 10%, extra freeze 8%, 30-min private 5%, P57 tote 1.5%, a free month 0.5%. Then choose: keep it, double it by booking 9 classes in your first 21 days, or donate it to a friend as a guest pass.
